mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has declined monotonically from -13.6% to -19.0% over three weeks, then rebounded to -13.4% at t-0w. As residential confinement eases (evidenced by declining residential premium), consumers redirect discretionary time to retail and recreation venues, driving RETAIL_REC upward over the next four weeks.

evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose from 6.0% to 8.1% over three weeks
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL continues rising above 8.5% while RETAIL_REC remains below -10%, indicating home-based activity is not substituting into retail.

The PARKS recovery will sustain, drawing discretionary mobility away from RETAIL_REC, which will decline further over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM stabilizes above -2.0% while RETAIL_REC continues falling below -15%, indicating essential and discretionary mobility are decoupled.
